title: Repeated outages at the plants
narrative: Four high-severity outages in 90 days at the Tuas and Senoko plants, low satisfaction, and the operations director has asked Competitor A for a secondary link.

title: Healthy manufacturer, ready for 5G+
narrative: Same industry and size as Kestrelwick. Recent QBR, spend up, no severe cases. The plant floor is a natural fit for 5G+.

title: Renewal in 60 days, Competitor B pricing pressure
narrative: Contract ends in 60 days with no renewal opportunity open. Procurement cites a cheaper bundle from Competitor B twice. Spend is flat.

title: Healthy wealth manager, quantum-safe interest
narrative: Same industry and size as Halvora. Renewal is ten months away and on track. Asked about quantum-safe options at the last QBR.

title: Champion left, relationship gone quiet
narrative: The CIO who championed Singtel left in August. No meeting in four months, the CFO has not replied, and IoT was downgraded in September.

title: Healthy health network, growing headcount
narrative: Same industry and size as Wattlegrove. Champion in place, recent QBR, IoT upgraded. Two new clinics planned: grow what they already buy.

title: IoT moved to Competitor C, RFP open
narrative: IoT shelf sensors were moved to Competitor C in September, spend is down 35% over three months, and a store connectivity RFP is open with Competitor C shortlisted.

title: Healthy retailer opening a distribution centre
narrative: Same industry and size as Saffronvale. Spend up 10%, recent QBR, and a second distribution centre is planned: a fit for 5G+.

title: Healthy logistics group, 5G+ added this year
narrative: Group parent of the Indonesia subsidiary. Owns five of six products, added 5G+ in June, recent QBR. Grow what they already buy.

title: New Indonesian warehouses off the Singtel network
narrative: The Indonesia subsidiary opened two warehouses since August on local broadband, off the Singtel network, and both now log performance cases.
